df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')
# Check if revenue contains non-numeric characters
has_non_numeric = df['revenue'].str.contains(r'[^\d.+-]', na=False)
print(f'Rows with non-numeric characters in revenue: {has_non_numeric.sum()}')
# Check for thousands separators (e.g., commas)
has_comma = df['revenue'].str.contains(',', na=False)
print(f'Rows with commas in revenue: {has_comma.sum()}')
# Check if the values are valid numbers after removing commas
if has_comma.any():
    df['revenue_clean'] = df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '', regex=False)
    print(f'Number of rows after removing commas: {len(df)}')
    # Verify that all are now numeric
    is_numeric = pd.to_numeric(df['revenue_clean'], errors='coerce').notna()
    print(f'Rows with non-numeric values after cleaning: {is_numeric.sum()}')"}}
